events.headline: US aviation shutdown blamed on L3 Harris installed router
events.summary: Officials are investigating whether an L3Harris-installed router triggered instability across 17 of 22 FAA en route centers, following a nationwide ground stop and widespread flight disruption. The precise failure cause remains undetermined.

events.headline: US floated idea of Ukraine ceding Donbas for NATO membership, Zelenskiy says
events.summary: Zelenskiy said US negotiators floated a possible Donbas withdrawal linked to NATO membership, while Kyiv rejected unilateral territorial concessions. Talks ended without a breakthrough but included an agreement in principle on a prisoner exchange.

events.headline: Trump tells advisers he may hold off on Iran attacks barring new provocations, sources say
events.summary: Reuters sources said Trump is considering refraining from further strikes on Iran absent new provocations, following calls for restraint from Saudi Arabia and Turkey. A final decision has not been made, leaving oil-market geopolitical risk elevated.

events.headline: ASEAN not easing Myanmar approach, bloc's special envoy says
events.summary: ASEAN's envoy said the bloc is maintaining its Five-Point Consensus approach to Myanmar while discussing proposals for participation in high-level meetings. Leaders are set to review the issue at the November 15-17 summit.
